title: Chinese memory manufacturer CXMT soars 466% in Shanghai stock market debut
summary: The Chinese DRAM company debuted on the stock exchange with a record rise, allocating funds to memory production.

title: Microsoft launches its own cybersecurity model MAI-Cyber-1 along with an agentic system
summary: The AI model strengthens Microsoft's security, although it still resorts to OpenAI for the most demanding tasks.

title: Nvidia considers backing $250 billion for OpenAI's data center in Ohio
summary: A potential deal would allow OpenAI to lease SoftBank's 10-gigawatt campus with financial backing from Nvidia.

title: A gamer builds a Steam Deck with spikes, taser, and Raspberry Pi to prevent family from using it
summary: The security system includes 3D spikes, a stun gun, and a Raspberry Pi with an alarm to protect the device's battery.

title: Minecraft Java Edition increases RAM requirements for the first time in 17 years to 16 GB
summary: The game raises recommended memory from 4 to 16 GB ahead of the transition to Vulkan, affecting players with older hardware.

title: AMD confirms Zen 7 will be the last generation for AM5 socket and Zen 8 will require AM6 and DDR6
summary: AMD's roadmap predicts that Zen 7 processors will complete the life of AM5, while Zen 8 will jump to AM6 and DDR6, with three EPYC families for 2028.

title: Apple delays its smart glasses until late 2027 to solve privacy issues
summary: The company seeks to differentiate itself from Meta's Ray-Ban by guaranteeing privacy, delaying the launch to overcome technical challenges.

title: Chinese AI Moonshot releases open weights of its Kimi-K3 model and competes with OpenAI
summary: The open model Kimi-K3 offers performance nearly equal to frontier models at up to three times lower computational cost.

title: Xbox online services suffer global outage days after PlayStation disruption
summary: The Xbox service outage affected users worldwide, reigniting debate about reliance on digital games.

title: Forest fires in central Spain mobilize Starlink and trigger emergency labor measures
summary: Smoke from fires in Madrid, Ávila, and Toledo crosses the peninsula, Starlink offers free internet, and the government grants four days of paid leave.

title: European payment system Wero advances with Decathlon and Lidl joining
summary: Wero, the alternative to Visa and Mastercard promoted by European banks, gains ground as it is adopted by large retail chains.

title: MSI and Colorful raise RTX 50 prices in China by up to 38% above recommended price
summary: The rise in memory and component costs forces manufacturers to increase prices of their RTX 50 series graphics cards.

title: NVIDIA uses its own Vera CPU to design future chips with up to 50% better performance
summary: Initial tests of the Vera CPU show significant improvements in automation and semiconductor design, paving the way for new generations.
